Beans do not need expensive chemicals, so I will put manure from my homestead on it to help it grow, but I will not buy chemical fertilizer or improved seed. My family will manage the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves because the plot is too small to require hired help, and we have no need for irrigation or pesticides on beans.
